description: Tao Jiang and Shaowei Cai (2026, preprint), A Better Analysis For PPSZ For 3-SAT, arXiv:2607.10697, Corollary 1.2: randomized general 3-SAT in time O*(1.307031578^n). OpenAI's introduction (openai/math 7ef5c0c, main_full_version.tex lines 228-230) cites it as the bound for general 3-SAT. Scheder, PPSZ is better than you think (TheoretiCS 3, 2024, doi 10.46298/theoretics.24.5) states no numerical 3-SAT bound; its ECCC version gives O*(1.307031594^n).
